digest.component_or_area: inbound-probe dispatch chain / reconciler differ / binding store
propositions: The (inbound, probe) dispatch chain has no live producer because differ._compute_mutations_emit_absent_partner_probes never fires: it requires local_state entries carrying jira_key, but run_differs passes a fetched Jira snapshot whose entries never carry jira_key.
Deletion-vs-aged-out discrimination is already implemented and live via outbound_differ._safe_get_issue (direct GET→404) and binding_walk.py bounded-GET loop, both in the same pass.

A confirmed hard-deleted issue whose local ticket remains present is currently resurrected after 3 grace passes when the binding retires and the local ticket becomes unbound, violating the operator ruling that deleted issues should not be resurrected.

The resurrection implementation (the inbound-delete dispatcher, _apply_inbound_delete, create_after_hard_delete follow-on) must be removed, not orphaned, and a tombstone guard must prevent outbound create for retired bindings.
BindingStore lacks reverse-lookup APIs is_retired_local(local_id) and unretire(jira_key) needed to check and reverse retirement by local ticket.

The dormant absence-probe port capability (probe_remote, SupportsAbsenceProbe, inbound_probe.py) is retained because Cloud and DC both implement it and removing it weakens epic e369 AC5 (both-backends claim on classify_probe_response).
